props.name: pressed
props.description: Whether the button is pressed. Controlled: changing it updates the control, so it can reflect external selection state. For uncontrolled use, pass it once and drive clicks via `onPressedChange`.

props.name: check
props.description: Show a leading checkmark when pressed (the filter-chip look) — reveals the selected state explicitly, the way a checkbox does. Pairs with `ToggleGroup` for multi-select filter chips.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; required when `children` is icon-only.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name — when checked, submits `value` under it.

props.name: value
props.description: Value submitted under `name` when pressed.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message, shown after the button and announced. The button points at it through `aria-describedby`. The app owns it: a form reset leaves it in place, so the app clears it.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Called whenever `pressed` changes.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Whether the button is pressed. `v-model` binds it two ways; passing it once and driving clicks through `onPressedChange` works as well.
